fitting_specification: Fit treatment-only Cox partial likelihood and project each arm through the Breslow baseline. For jackknife uncertainty, assign every participant one of 20 group labels within randomized-arm strata before inspecting outcomes, so that each label is represented approximately equally in each arm. Within each arm, encode each participant identifier as UTF-8, order participants by the raw SHA-256 digest of that encoding, and assign labels 0 through 19 cyclically in that order. For each of the G = 20 refits, delete all participants carrying one label from every arm, then refit the nuisance and target models. Retain the reproducible group assignment with the analysis code. If theta[-g] is the complete-refit estimate after deleting group g, calculate SE = sqrt((G - 1) / G * sum_g((theta[-g] - mean_g(theta[-g]))^2)). Form the two-sided 95% interval around the full-sample estimate using the 0.975 Student-t quantile with G - 1 degrees of freedom.
